title: 提示链实践：自动化学术报告生成的案例研究
summary: 本文提出并评估了多阶段提示链方法用于自动化学术摘要生成，系统AI SciBrief实现该方法。实验显示提示链成功率100%，优于单次提示的50%，ROUGE-L F1分数更高（0.507 vs 0.486），表明提示链是复杂生成任务更可靠有效的工程方法。
summary_en: This paper introduces and evaluates a multi-stage prompt chaining method for automated scholarly digest generation, implemented in AI SciBrief. Experiments show 100% success rate vs 50% for single-shot, with higher ROUGE-L F1 (0.507 vs 0.486), demonstrating prompt chaining as a more reliable engineering approach.
